// [IP-S1] Activité de l'IP par jour — Statistics / Adresse IP
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.1.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 10080) * 1m; // défaut : 7d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // défaut : 1d
let StartTime = T0 - Before;
let EndTime = T0 + After;

let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Ouverture de session réussie",
        id == 4625, "Échec d'ouverture de session",
        id == 4634, "Fermeture de session",
        id == 4647, "Déconnexion initiée par l'utilisateur",
        id == 4648, "Ouverture avec identifiants explicites",
        id == 4672, "Privilèges spéciaux attribués",
        id == 4688, "Création de processus",
        id == 4697, "Service installé",
        id == 4698, "Tâche planifiée créée",
        id == 4702, "Tâche planifiée modifiée",
        id == 4720, "Compte utilisateur créé",
        id == 4722, "Compte utilisateur activé",
        id == 4724, "Réinitialisation de mot de passe",
        id == 4728, "Membre ajouté à un groupe global de sécurité",
        id == 4732, "Membre ajouté à un groupe local de sécurité",
        id == 4740, "Compte verrouillé",
        id == 4756, "Membre ajouté à un groupe universel de sécurité",
        id == 4768, "Ticket Kerberos TGT demandé",
        id == 4769, "Ticket de service Kerberos demandé",
        id == 4771, "Échec de pré-authentification Kerberos",
        id == 4776, "Validation d'identifiants NTLM",
        id == 4778, "Session RDP reconnectée",
        id == 4779, "Session RDP déconnectée",
        id == 5140, "Accès à un partage réseau",
        id == 5145, "Contrôle d'accès à un objet de partage",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)

// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// @requires: win_names
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(CommandLine, extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TaskContent = coalesce(extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(MemberName, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(MemberSid, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(ServiceFileName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(ShareName, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(RelativeTargetName, extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(ObjectName, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(AccessMask, extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(PrivilegeList, extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "SecurityEvent"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AuthenticationPackageName), tostring(EventData.PackageName), extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.WorkstationName), tostring(EventData.Workstation), extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpPort), tostring(EventData.ClientPort), extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskContent = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskContent), tostring(EventData.TaskContentNew), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberName), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceFileName), tostring(EventData.ImagePath), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareName), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.RelativeTargetName), extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessMask), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
// Connexions Entra ID interactives et non interactives, normalisées.
// Dans AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, DeviceDetail, Status et LocationDetails sont des chaînes JSON :
// elles sont analysées pour obtenir les mêmes colonnes que SigninLogs.
// Paramètres : start, end, ip (vide = toutes), upn (vide = tous). Résultat : 0 = succès.
let _Signins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string, upn:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status, SignInType = "Interactive"
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status), SignInType = "NonInteractive"
    )
    | extend
        DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
        DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId),
        OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
        Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
        IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged),
        IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
        TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
        City = tostring(_loc.city),
        FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
        Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    | project TimeGenerated, SignInType, UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName,
        ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason, Succeeded, IPAddress, Location, City, AutonomousSystemNumber,
        ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId, OperatingSystem, Browser, IsManaged, IsCompliant, TrustType,
        ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
};
// Toutes les source de journaux où apparaîssent une adresse IP, ramenée à des colonnes communes :
// TimeGenerated, Source, EventType (EventID, ActionType ou opération), Host, Account, Detail.
// @requires: win_security, signins
let _IpEvents = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Signins(start, end, ip, "")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = DeviceName, Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = AppDisplayName
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(start, end, dynamic([]), ip)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, EventType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
            Host = Computer, Account = TargetSam, Detail = LogonTypeName
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip or LocalIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
    ),
    (
        DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(AccountName), Detail = LogonType
    ),
    (
        IdentityLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip or DestinationIPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = coalesce(DeviceName, DestinationDeviceName),
            Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudAppEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Detail = Application
    ),
    (
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where ClientIP has ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "OfficeActivity", EventType = Operation, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(UserId), Detail = OfficeWorkload
    ),
    (
        AzureActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", EventType = OperationNameValue, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(Caller), Detail = ResourceGroup
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity), Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(coalesce(SourceUserName, DestinationUserName)), Detail = strcat(SourceIP, " → ", DestinationIP, ":", tostring(DestinationPort))
    ),
    (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SenderIPv4 == ip or SenderIPv6 == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailEvents", EventType = DeliveryAction, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(SenderFromAddress), Detail = Subject
    ),
    (
        UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClickEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountUpn), Detail = Url
    )
};
_IpEvents(StartTime, EndTime, Value)
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Source
| render timechart

// Connexions Entra ID interactives et non interactives, normalisées.
// Dans AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, DeviceDetail, Status et LocationDetails sont des chaînes JSON :
// elles sont analysées pour obtenir les mêmes colonnes que SigninLogs.
// Paramètres : start, end, ip (vide = toutes), upn (vide = tous). Résultat : 0 = succès.
let _Signins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string, upn:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status, SignInType = "Interactive"
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status), SignInType = "NonInteractive"
    )
    | extend
        DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
        DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId),
        OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
        Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
        IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged),
        IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
        TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
        City = tostring(_loc.city),
        FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
        Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    | project TimeGenerated, SignInType, UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName,
        ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason, Succeeded, IPAddress, Location, City, AutonomousSystemNumber,
        ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId, OperatingSystem, Browser, IsManaged, IsCompliant, TrustType,
        ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
};
// Toutes les source de journaux où apparaîssent une adresse IP, ramenée à des colonnes communes :
// TimeGenerated, Source, EventType (EventID, ActionType ou opération), Host, Account, Detail.
// @requires: win_security, signins
let _IpEvents = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Signins(start, end, ip, "")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = DeviceName, Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = AppDisplayName
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(start, end, dynamic([]), ip)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, EventType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
            Host = Computer, Account = TargetSam, Detail = LogonTypeName
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip or LocalIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
    ),
    (
        DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(AccountName), Detail = LogonType
    ),
    (
        IdentityLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip or DestinationIPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = coalesce(DeviceName, DestinationDeviceName),
            Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudAppEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Detail = Application
    ),
    (
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where ClientIP has ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "OfficeActivity", EventType = Operation, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(UserId), Detail = OfficeWorkload
    ),
    (
        AzureActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", EventType = OperationNameValue, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(Caller), Detail = ResourceGroup
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity), Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(coalesce(SourceUserName, DestinationUserName)), Detail = strcat(SourceIP, " → ", DestinationIP, ":", tostring(DestinationPort))
    ),
    (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SenderIPv4 == ip or SenderIPv6 == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailEvents", EventType = DeliveryAction, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(SenderFromAddress), Detail = Subject
    ),
    (
        UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClickEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountUpn), Detail = Url
    )
};
_IpEvents(StartTime, EndTime, Value)
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), Serie = strcat(Source, " · ", EventType)
| render timechart

rules.name: Utilisation par jour, par machine
rules.description: Tableau croisé machine × jour du nombre d'événements où l'IP apparaît (connexions réseau Defender, journaux Windows, Defender for Identity, pare-feu). Montre les machines contactées pour la première fois.

reading.decisive: Machines touchées uniquement le jour de l'alerte, alors que l'IP existait déjà avant.
reading.context: Nombre de machines qui augmente d'un jour à l'autre (balayage, mouvement latéral).
reading.noise: Serveurs de supervision, d'inventaire ou de sauvegarde contactés tous les jours.

// [IP-S3] Utilisation par jour, par machine — Statistics / Adresse IP
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.1.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 10080) * 1m; // défaut : 7d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // défaut : 1d
let StartTime = T0 - Before;
let EndTime = T0 + After;

// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :

// Connexions Entra ID interactives et non interactives, normalisées.
// Dans AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, DeviceDetail, Status et LocationDetails sont des chaînes JSON :
// elles sont analysées pour obtenir les mêmes colonnes que SigninLogs.
// Paramètres : start, end, ip (vide = toutes), upn (vide = tous). Résultat : 0 = succès.
let _Signins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string, upn:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status, SignInType = "Interactive"
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status), SignInType = "NonInteractive"
    )
    | extend
        DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
        DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId),
        OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
        Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
        IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged),
        IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
        TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
        City = tostring(_loc.city),
        FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
        Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    | project TimeGenerated, SignInType, UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName,
        ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason, Succeeded, IPAddress, Location, City, AutonomousSystemNumber,
        ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId, OperatingSystem, Browser, IsManaged, IsCompliant, TrustType,
        ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
};
// Toutes les source de journaux où apparaîssent une adresse IP, ramenée à des colonnes communes :
// TimeGenerated, Source, EventType (EventID, ActionType ou opération), Host, Account, Detail.
// @requires: win_security, signins
let _IpEvents = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Signins(start, end, ip, "")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = DeviceName, Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = AppDisplayName
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(start, end, dynamic([]), ip)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, EventType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
            Host = Computer, Account = TargetSam, Detail = LogonTypeName
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip or LocalIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
    ),
    (
        DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(AccountName), Detail = LogonType
    ),
    (
        IdentityLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip or DestinationIPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = coalesce(DeviceName, DestinationDeviceName),
            Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudAppEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Detail = Application
    ),
    (
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where ClientIP has ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "OfficeActivity", EventType = Operation, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(UserId), Detail = OfficeWorkload
    ),
    (
        AzureActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", EventType = OperationNameValue, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(Caller), Detail = ResourceGroup
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity), Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(coalesce(SourceUserName, DestinationUserName)), Detail = strcat(SourceIP, " → ", DestinationIP, ":", tostring(DestinationPort))
    ),
    (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SenderIPv4 == ip or SenderIPv6 == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailEvents", EventType = DeliveryAction, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(SenderFromAddress), Detail = Subject
    ),
    (
        UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClickEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountUpn), Detail = Url
    )
};
_IpEvents(StartTime, EndTime, Value)
| where isnotempty(Host)
| summarize Events = count() by Machine = tolower(Host), Day = format_datetime(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), "yyyy-MM-dd")
| evaluate pivot(Day, sum(Events), Machine)

            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

// Connexions Entra ID interactives et non interactives, normalisées.
// Dans AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, DeviceDetail, Status et LocationDetails sont des chaînes JSON :
// elles sont analysées pour obtenir les mêmes colonnes que SigninLogs.
// Paramètres : start, end, ip (vide = toutes), upn (vide = tous). Résultat : 0 = succès.
let _Signins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string, upn:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status, SignInType = "Interactive"
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status), SignInType = "NonInteractive"
    )
    | extend
        DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
        DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId),
        OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
        Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
        IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged),
        IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
        TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
        City = tostring(_loc.city),
        FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
        Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    | project TimeGenerated, SignInType, UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName,
        ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason, Succeeded, IPAddress, Location, City, AutonomousSystemNumber,
        ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId, OperatingSystem, Browser, IsManaged, IsCompliant, TrustType,
        ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
};
// Toutes les source de journaux où apparaîssent une adresse IP, ramenée à des colonnes communes :
// TimeGenerated, Source, EventType (EventID, ActionType ou opération), Host, Account, Detail.
// @requires: win_security, signins
let _IpEvents = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Signins(start, end, ip, "")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = DeviceName, Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = AppDisplayName
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(start, end, dynamic([]), ip)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, EventType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
            Host = Computer, Account = TargetSam, Detail = LogonTypeName
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip or LocalIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
    ),
    (
        DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(AccountName), Detail = LogonType
    ),
    (
        IdentityLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip or DestinationIPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = coalesce(DeviceName, DestinationDeviceName),
            Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudAppEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Detail = Application
    ),
    (
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where ClientIP has ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "OfficeActivity", EventType = Operation, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(UserId), Detail = OfficeWorkload
    ),
    (
        AzureActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", EventType = OperationNameValue, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(Caller), Detail = ResourceGroup
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity), Host = DeviceName,
            Account = tolower(coalesce(SourceUserName, DestinationUserName)), Detail = strcat(SourceIP, " → ", DestinationIP, ":", tostring(DestinationPort))
    ),
    (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SenderIPv4 == ip or SenderIPv6 == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailEvents", EventType = DeliveryAction, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(SenderFromAddress), Detail = Subject
    ),
    (
        UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClickEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountUpn), Detail = Url
    )
};
_IpEvents(StartTime, EndTime, Value)
| where isnotempty(Account) and Account != "-"
| summarize Events = count() by Account, Day = format_datetime(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), "yyyy-MM-dd")
| evaluate pivot(Day, sum(Events), Account)

rules.name: Machines liées à l'IP
rules.description: Retrouve le nom de la ou des machines derrière une IP : adresse attribuée à une carte réseau (DeviceNetworkInfo), IP locale de connexions (DeviceNetworkEvents), IP publique de sortie (DeviceInfo), poste source vu par les contrôleurs de domaine et serveurs (4624, 4625, 4648, 4768, 4769, 4771, 4776 dans SecurityEvent et WindowsEvent), poste distant vu par Defender (DeviceLogonEvents) et Defender for Identity.

reading.decisive: Une IP attribuée par DeviceNetworkInfo sur la période donne le nom de la machine avec certitude.
reading.context: Un poste source vu seulement dans les événements 4624 ou 4776 (champ WorkstationName, déclaratif).
reading.noise: IP de NAT, de VPN ou de serveur de rebond qui ramène plusieurs dizaines de machines.

// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// @requires: win_names
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceNetworkInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTime - 1d) .. EndTime)
    | where IPAddresses has Value
    | mv-expand Ip = IPAddresses
    | where tostring(Ip.IPAddress) == Value
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Machine = tolower(DeviceName), Evidence = strcat("IP attribuée à ", NetworkAdapterName, " (", MacAddress, ")"), Source = "DeviceNetworkInfo"
),
(
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where LocalIP == Value
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Machine = tolower(DeviceName), Evidence = "IP locale de connexions réseau", Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents"
),
(
    DeviceInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTime - 1d) .. EndTime)
    | where PublicIP == Value
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Machine = tolower(DeviceName), Evidence = "IP publique de sortie", Source = "DeviceInfo"
),
(
    _WinSecurity(StartTime, EndTime, dynamic([4624, 4625, 4648, 4768, 4769, 4771, 4776]), Value)
    | where IpAddress == Value and isnotempty(WorkstationName)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Machine = tolower(WorkstationName), Evidence = strcat("Poste source déclaré, vu par ", tolower(Computer)), Source = SourceTable
),
(
    DeviceLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where RemoteIP == Value and isnotempty(RemoteDeviceName)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Machine = tolower(RemoteDeviceName), Evidence = strcat("Poste distant vu par ", tolower(DeviceName)), Source = "DeviceLogonEvents"
),
(
    IdentityLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where IPAddress == Value and isnotempty(DeviceName)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Machine = tolower(DeviceName), Evidence = strcat("Source ", Protocol, " vers ", Application), Source = "IdentityLogonEvents"
)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen), Events = sum(Events),
    Evidence = make_set(Evidence, 10), Sources = make_set(Source) by Machine
| extend ConfidenceRank = case(
    set_has_element(Sources, "DeviceNetworkInfo") or set_has_element(Sources, "DeviceNetworkEvents"), 1,
    array_length(Sources) > 1, 2,
    3)
| extend Confidence = case(ConfidenceRank == 1, "Élevée : IP portée par la machine",
    ConfidenceRank == 2, "Moyenne : plusieurs sources concordantes",
    "Faible : nom déclaré par une seule source")
| sort by ConfidenceRank asc, LastSeen desc
| project-away ConfidenceRank

rules.name: Comptes connectés depuis l'IP
rules.description: Comptes qui ont tenté de s'authentifier depuis l'IP : Entra ID (interactif et non interactif), Windows (4624, 4625, 4648, 4768, 4769, 4771, 4776 via SecurityEvent et WindowsEvent), Defender for Endpoint et Defender for Identity. Donne tentatives, succès, échecs et premier succès par compte.

reading.decisive: Un succès précédé d'échecs sur de nombreux comptes depuis la même IP (spray réussi).
reading.context: Plusieurs comptes d'une même campagne de phishing connectés depuis la même IP.
reading.noise: IP de NAT, de VPN ou de serveur Citrix qui porte des centaines de comptes légitimes.

rules.query:
// [IP-P2] Comptes connectés depuis l'IP — Pivot / Adresse IP
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.1.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // défaut : 24h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // défaut : 1h
let StartTime = T0 - Before;
let EndTime = T0 + After;

// Connexions Entra ID interactives et non interactives, normalisées.
// Dans AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, DeviceDetail, Status et LocationDetails sont des chaînes JSON :
// elles sont analysées pour obtenir les mêmes colonnes que SigninLogs.
// Paramètres : start, end, ip (vide = toutes), upn (vide = tous). Résultat : 0 = succès.
let _Signins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string, upn:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status, SignInType = "Interactive"
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status), SignInType = "NonInteractive"
    )
    | extend
        DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
        DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId),
        OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
        Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
        IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged),
        IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
        TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
        City = tostring(_loc.city),
        FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
        Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    | project TimeGenerated, SignInType, UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName,
        ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason, Succeeded, IPAddress, Location, City, AutonomousSystemNumber,
        ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId, OperatingSystem, Browser, IsManaged, IsCompliant, TrustType,
        ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
};
let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Ouverture de session réussie",
        id == 4625, "Échec d'ouverture de session",
        id == 4634, "Fermeture de session",
        id == 4647, "Déconnexion initiée par l'utilisateur",
        id == 4648, "Ouverture avec identifiants explicites",
        id == 4672, "Privilèges spéciaux attribués",
        id == 4688, "Création de processus",
        id == 4697, "Service installé",
        id == 4698, "Tâche planifiée créée",
        id == 4702, "Tâche planifiée modifiée",
        id == 4720, "Compte utilisateur créé",
        id == 4722, "Compte utilisateur activé",
        id == 4724, "Réinitialisation de mot de passe",
        id == 4728, "Membre ajouté à un groupe global de sécurité",
        id == 4732, "Membre ajouté à un groupe local de sécurité",
        id == 4740, "Compte verrouillé",
        id == 4756, "Membre ajouté à un groupe universel de sécurité",
        id == 4768, "Ticket Kerberos TGT demandé",
        id == 4769, "Ticket de service Kerberos demandé",
        id == 4771, "Échec de pré-authentification Kerberos",
        id == 4776, "Validation d'identifiants NTLM",
        id == 4778, "Session RDP reconnectée",
        id == 4779, "Session RDP déconnectée",
        id == 5140, "Accès à un partage réseau",
        id == 5145, "Contrôle d'accès à un objet de partage",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)
};
// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// @requires: win_names
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(CommandLine, extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TaskContent = coalesce(extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(MemberName, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(MemberSid, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(ServiceFileName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(ShareName, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(RelativeTargetName, extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(ObjectName, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(AccessMask, extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(PrivilegeList, extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "SecurityEvent"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AuthenticationPackageName), tostring(EventData.PackageName), extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.WorkstationName), tostring(EventData.Workstation), extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpPort), tostring(EventData.ClientPort), extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskContent = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskContent), tostring(EventData.TaskContentNew), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberName), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceFileName), tostring(EventData.ImagePath), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareName), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.RelativeTargetName), extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessMask), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
union isfuzzy=true
(
    _Signins(StartTime, EndTime, Value, "")
    | project TimeGenerated, Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Source = strcat("Entra ID ", SignInType),
        Success = Succeeded, Target = AppDisplayName, Detail = iff(Succeeded, Location, strcat(ResultType, " ", FailureReason))
),
(
    _WinSecurity(StartTime, EndTime, dynamic([4624, 4625, 4648, 4768, 4769, 4771, 4776]), Value)
    | where IpAddress == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Account = iff(isempty(TargetDomainName) or TargetDomainName == "-", TargetSam, tolower(strcat(TargetDomainName, @"\", TargetSam))),
        Source = SourceTable, Success = EventID !in (4625, 4771) and Status in ("", "-", "0x0"),
        Target = tolower(Computer), Detail = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", LogonTypeName, " ", Status)
),
(
    DeviceLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where RemoteIP == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Account = tolower(strcat(AccountDomain, @"\", AccountName)), Source = "DeviceLogonEvents",
        Success = ActionType == "LogonSuccess", Target = tolower(DeviceName), Detail = strcat(LogonType, " ", FailureReason)
),
(
    IdentityLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where IPAddress == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Source = "IdentityLogonEvents",
        Success = ActionType == "LogonSuccess", Target = tolower(coalesce(DestinationDeviceName, Application)), Detail = strcat(Protocol, " ", FailureReason)
)
| where isnotempty(Account) and Account !endswith "$"
| summarize Attempts = count(), Successes = countif(Success), Failures = countif(not(Success)),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), FirstSuccess = minif(TimeGenerated, Success), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Targets = make_set(Target, 20), Sources = make_set(Source), Details = make_set(Detail, 10) by Account
| sort by Successes desc, Attempts desc
