    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
// _NormPath : chemin normalisé des chemins de fichiers
// (c:\users\jdoe\appdata\… → c:\users\*\appdata\…) pour regrouper un même binaire entre utilisateurs.
let _NormPath = (p:string) {
    let l = tolower(p);
    let u = indexof(l, @"\users\");
    let next = iff(u < 0, -1, indexof(l, @"\", u + 7));
    iff(u < 0 or next < 0, l, strcat(substring(l, 0, u + 7), "*", substring(l, next)))
};
// _IsUserWritable : dossier où un utilisateur standard peut écrire (emplacement inhabituel pour un exécutable).
let _IsUserWritable = (p:string) {
    tolower(p) has_any (@"\appdata\", @"\temp\", @"\downloads\", @"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\desktop\", @"\perflogs\")
};
union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where _IsPersistenceKey(RegistryKey, RegistryValueName)
    | project TimeGenerated, Mechanism = "Registre", Item = strcat(RegistryKey, @"\", RegistryValueName), Detail = RegistryValueData,
        Process = InitiatingProcessFileName, CommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
),
(
    DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where ActionType in (_PersistenceActions)
    | extend AF = parse_json(tostring(AdditionalFields))
    | project TimeGenerated, Mechanism = ActionType, Item = coalesce(tostring(AF.TaskName), tostring(AF.ServiceName), FileName),
        Detail = substring(coalesce(tostring(AF.TaskContent), FolderPath, tostring(AF)), 0, 1000),
        Process = InitiatingProcessFileName, CommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
),
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where (FileName in~ ("schtasks.exe", "at.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "/create")
        or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create", "config"))
        or (FileName =~ "reg.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "add" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("CurrentVersion\\Run", "Winlogon", "Image File Execution Options"))
        or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "wmic.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Register-ScheduledTask", "New-ScheduledTask", "New-Service", "__EventFilter", "CommandLineEventConsumer"))
    | project TimeGenerated, Mechanism = "Commande", Item = FileName, Detail = ProcessCommandLine,
        Process = InitiatingProcessFileName, CommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
),
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated" and FolderPath has @"\Start Menu\Programs\Startup"
    | project TimeGenerated, Mechanism = "Dossier Démarrage", Item = FileName, Detail = FolderPath,
        Process = InitiatingProcessFileName, CommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
),
(
    _WinSecurity(StartTime, EndTime, dynamic([4697, 4698, 4702, 4720, 4732]), ValueShort)
    | where _IsHost(Computer)
    | project TimeGenerated, Mechanism = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
        Item = coalesce(TaskName, ServiceName, TargetUserName),
        Detail = substring(coalesce(TaskContent, ServiceFileName, MemberName), 0, 1000),
        Process = strcat(SubjectDomainName, @"\", SubjectUserName), CommandLine = ""
)
| extend UserWritablePath = _IsUserWritable(Detail)
| sort by TimeGenerated asc

rules.name: Fichiers téléchargés puis exécutés
rules.description: Fichiers écrits sur la machine (avec URL d'origine, ou dans Téléchargements, Temp, cache Outlook ou du navigateur) puis exécutés dans les 10 minutes, rapprochés par SHA256. Donne le délai, l'URL, le processus qui a écrit le fichier et celui qui l'a lancé.

reading.decisive: Exécutable ou script venant d'un domaine récent, lancé en moins de 10 minutes, avec enfant LOLBin ou connexion sortante.
reading.context: Fichier écrit par 7-Zip, WinRAR ou l'explorateur depuis une archive téléchargée.
reading.noise: Installations faites par l'utilisateur depuis le site officiel de l'éditeur.

rules.name: Timeline de la machine
rules.description: Déroulé autour de T0 sur la machine : processus, premier contact avec chaque destination publique, fichiers exécutables, scripts et archives écrits, ouvertures de session, clés de persistance, événements Defender notables (antivirus, ASR, altération, injection, tâches, services), alertes et événements Windows clés (4624, 4625, 4672, 4688, 4697, 4698, 4720, 4732). Limité à 5 000 lignes.

reading.decisive: Enchaînement processus inhabituel → fichier déposé → persistance → connexion sortante, avec alerte associée.
reading.context: Ouverture de session distante juste avant l'activité suspecte (mouvement latéral entrant).
reading.noise: Activité de fond (mises à jour, agents de gestion, antivirus).

rules.query:
// [MC-T1] Timeline de la machine — Timeline / Machine
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.1.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 30) * 1m; // défaut : 30m
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 30) * 1m; // défaut : 30m
let StartTime = T0 - Before;
let EndTime = T0 + After;
// Indicateur Machine : comparaison sur le nom court (avant le premier point), insensible à la casse,
// pour rapprocher DeviceName (FQDN Defender) et Computer (FQDN ou NetBIOS Windows).
let ValueHost = tolower(Value);
let ValueShort = tostring(split(ValueHost, ".")[0]);
let _IsHost = (h:string) { tolower(tostring(split(h, ".")[0])) == ValueShort };
// Clés de registre et actions Defender associées à la persistance.
let _PersistenceKeys = dynamic([
    @"\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\CurrentVersion\RunOnce", @"\CurrentVersion\RunServices",
    @"\Policies\Explorer\Run", @"\CurrentVersion\Winlogon", @"\Image File Execution Options",
    @"\CurrentControlSet\Services", @"\Explorer\Shell Folders", @"\Explorer\User Shell Folders",
    @"\Session Manager\BootExecute", @"\Windows\AppInit_DLLs", @"\Environment\UserInitMprLogonScript"]);
let _PersistenceActions = dynamic(["ScheduledTaskCreated", "ScheduledTaskUpdated", "ServiceInstalled",
    "WmiBindEventFilterToConsumer"]);
let _IsPersistenceKey = (key:string, valueName:string) {
    key has_any (_PersistenceKeys)
    and (key !has @"\CurrentControlSet\Services" or valueName in~ ("ImagePath", "ServiceDll", "FailureCommand"))
};
let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Ouverture de session réussie",
        id == 4625, "Échec d'ouverture de session",
        id == 4634, "Fermeture de session",
        id == 4647, "Déconnexion initiée par l'utilisateur",
        id == 4648, "Ouverture avec identifiants explicites",
        id == 4672, "Privilèges spéciaux attribués",
        id == 4688, "Création de processus",
        id == 4697, "Service installé",
        id == 4698, "Tâche planifiée créée",
        id == 4702, "Tâche planifiée modifiée",
        id == 4720, "Compte utilisateur créé",
        id == 4722, "Compte utilisateur activé",
        id == 4724, "Réinitialisation de mot de passe",
        id == 4728, "Membre ajouté à un groupe global de sécurité",
        id == 4732, "Membre ajouté à un groupe local de sécurité",
        id == 4740, "Compte verrouillé",
        id == 4756, "Membre ajouté à un groupe universel de sécurité",
        id == 4768, "Ticket Kerberos TGT demandé",
        id == 4769, "Ticket de service Kerberos demandé",
        id == 4771, "Échec de pré-authentification Kerberos",
        id == 4776, "Validation d'identifiants NTLM",
        id == 4778, "Session RDP reconnectée",
        id == 4779, "Session RDP déconnectée",
        id == 5140, "Accès à un partage réseau",
        id == 5145, "Contrôle d'accès à un objet de partage",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)
};
// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// @requires: win_names
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(CommandLine, extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TaskContent = coalesce(extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(MemberName, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(MemberSid, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(ServiceFileName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(ShareName, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(RelativeTargetName, extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(ObjectName, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(AccessMask, extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(PrivilegeList, extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "SecurityEvent"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AuthenticationPackageName), tostring(EventData.PackageName), extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.WorkstationName), tostring(EventData.Workstation), extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpPort), tostring(EventData.ClientPort), extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskContent = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskContent), tostring(EventData.TaskContentNew), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberName), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceFileName), tostring(EventData.ImagePath), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareName), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.RelativeTargetName), extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessMask), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
let Notable = dynamic(["Antivirus", "Asr", "Tamper", "Injection", "ScheduledTask", "ServiceInstalled", "Exploit",
    "SmartScreen", "PowerShellCommand", "Amsi", "Wmi", "Lsass", "Credential"]);
union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceProcessEvents", Host = tolower(DeviceName), Account = tolower(AccountName),
        Action = strcat("Processus ", FileName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", ProcessCommandLine)
),
(
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated), Account = take_any(InitiatingProcessAccountName)
        by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, Destination = coalesce(RemoteUrl, RemoteIP), RemotePort
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", Host = tolower(DeviceName), Account = tolower(Account),
        Action = strcat("Premier contact · ", InitiatingProcessFileName), Detail = strcat(Destination, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
),
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(exe|dll|sys|ps1|psm1|bat|cmd|vbs|vbe|js|jse|wsf|hta|msi|lnk|scr|zip|iso|img|rar|7z)$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceFileEvents", Host = tolower(DeviceName), Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName),
        Action = strcat("Fichier ", ActionType), Detail = strcat(FolderPath, " ← ", InitiatingProcessFileName, iff(isempty(FileOriginUrl), "", strcat(" ← ", FileOriginUrl)))
),
(
    DeviceLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", Host = tolower(DeviceName), Account = tolower(strcat(AccountDomain, @"\", AccountName)),
        Action = strcat(ActionType, " ", LogonType), Detail = strcat(RemoteIP, " ", RemoteDeviceName)
),
(
    DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where _IsPersistenceKey(RegistryKey, RegistryValueName)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceRegistryEvents", Host = tolower(DeviceName), Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName),
        Action = ActionType, Detail = strcat(RegistryKey, @"\", RegistryValueName, " = ", RegistryValueData)
),
(
    DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where ActionType has_any (Notable)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceEvents", Host = tolower(DeviceName), Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName),
        Action = ActionType, Detail = strcat(FileName, " · ", InitiatingProcessFileName, " · ", substring(tostring(AdditionalFields), 0, 300))
),
(
    AlertEvidence
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, Title, Severity, DeviceName) by AlertId
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AlertEvidence", Host = tolower(DeviceName), Account = "",

| take 5000

rules.name: Prévalence du processus
rules.description: Exécutions du binaire sur 30 jours, par chemin (profil utilisateur remplacé par *) : machines, comptes, jours actifs, hash, éditeurs et parents. Repère un binaire légitime lancé depuis un emplacement anormal (node.exe dans AppData, copie de rundll32). Couvre aussi les 4688 Windows. Le contexte HOST restreint à une machine.

reading.decisive: Chemin modifiable par l'utilisateur (AppData, Temp, ProgramData) vu sur 1 à 3 machines, sans éditeur connu.
reading.context: Plusieurs hash pour un même nom et un même chemin, nom d'origine (OriginalFileName) différent du nom.
reading.noise: Outils de développement (node, python) sur les postes des développeurs.

// [PR-S1] Prévalence du processus — Statistics / Processus
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.1.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}, {{HOST}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 43200) * 1m; // défaut : 30d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // défaut : 1d
let StartTime = T0 - Before;
let EndTime = T0 + After;
let HostFilter = tolower(tostring(split(trim(@"\s", iff(@"{{HOST}}" startswith "{{", "", @"{{HOST}}")), ".")[0]));
// Indicateur Processus : nom de fichier (powershell.exe) ou chemin complet
let ValueFile = tolower(tostring(split(replace_string(Value, "/", @"\"), @"\")[-1]));
let ValuePath = iff(Value contains @"\" or Value contains "/", tolower(replace_string(Value, "/", @"\")), "");
// _NormPath : chemin normalisé des chemins de fichiers
// (c:\users\jdoe\appdata\… → c:\users\*\appdata\…) pour regrouper un même binaire entre utilisateurs.
let _NormPath = (p:string) {
    let l = tolower(p);
    let u = indexof(l, @"\users\");
    let next = iff(u < 0, -1, indexof(l, @"\", u + 7));
    iff(u < 0 or next < 0, l, strcat(substring(l, 0, u + 7), "*", substring(l, next)))
};
// _IsUserWritable : dossier où un utilisateur standard peut écrire (emplacement inhabituel pour un exécutable).

            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpPort), tostring(EventData.ClientPort), extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where FileName =~ ValueFile
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DeviceName startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceProcessEvents", DeviceName = tolower(DeviceName), AccountName = tolower(AccountName),
        FolderPath, SHA256, Company = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName, OriginalName = ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName, Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName
),
(
    _WinSecurity(StartTime, EndTime, dynamic([4688]), ValueFile)
    | where tolower(NewProcessName) endswith strcat(@"\", ValueFile)
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Computer startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, DeviceName = tolower(Computer), AccountName = tolower(SubjectUserName),
        FolderPath = NewProcessName, SHA256 = "", Company = "", OriginalName = "", Parent = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, @"\")[-1])
)
| extend NormPath = _NormPath(FolderPath)
| summarize Executions = count(), Machines = dcount(DeviceName), Accounts = dcount(AccountName), ActiveDays = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Hashes = make_set_if(SHA256, isnotempty(SHA256), 10),
    Companies = make_set_if(Company, isnotempty(Company), 5), OriginalNames = make_set_if(OriginalName, isnotempty(OriginalName), 5),
    Parents = make_set(Parent, 10), SampleMachines = make_set(DeviceName, 10), Sources = make_set(Source) by NormPath
| extend UserWritablePath = _IsUserWritable(NormPath)
| sort by UserWritablePath desc, Machines asc

rules.name: Parents et enfants du processus
rules.description: Arbre autour du processus : ses parents et grands-parents (quand il est lancé) et ses enfants (ce qu'il lance), avec lignes de commande, machines et comptes. Sources : DeviceProcessEvents et 4688 Windows. Par exemple, depuis explorer.exe on voit les exécutables lancés par l'utilisateur ; depuis powershell.exe on voit qui l'a lancé et avec quelles options. Si la valeur est un chemin complet, seul ce chemin est retenu.

reading.context: Enfant LOLBin (rundll32, regsvr32, certutil, msbuild, node) d'un processus inhabituel.
reading.noise: Scripts d'administration lancés par les agents de gestion (SCCM, Intune, RMM).

union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where FileName =~ ValueFile or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ ValueFile
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DeviceName startswith HostFilter
    | where isempty(ValuePath) or FolderPath =~ ValuePath or InitiatingProcessFolderPath =~ ValuePath
    | extend Role = iff(FileName =~ ValueFile, "1 · Lancement du processus", "2 · Enfant")
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceProcessEvents", DeviceName = tolower(DeviceName), Role,
        GrandParent = tolower(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), Parent = tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), Process = tolower(FileName),
        CommandLine = ProcessCommandLine, ParentCommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Account = tolower(AccountName)
),
(
    _WinSecurity(StartTime, EndTime, dynamic([4688]), ValueFile)
    | where tolower(NewProcessName) endswith strcat(@"\", ValueFile) or tolower(ParentProcessName) endswith strcat(@"\", ValueFile)
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Computer startswith HostFilter
    | extend Role = iff(tolower(NewProcessName) endswith strcat(@"\", ValueFile), "1 · Lancement du processus", "2 · Enfant")
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, DeviceName = tolower(Computer), Role, GrandParent = "",
        Parent = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, @"\")[-1])), Process = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, @"\")[-1])),
        CommandLine, ParentCommandLine = "", Account = tolower(SubjectUserName)
)
| summarize Executions = count(), Machines = dcount(DeviceName), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    CommandLines = make_set(CommandLine, 5), ParentCommandLines = make_set(ParentCommandLine, 3),
    SampleMachines = make_set(DeviceName, 5), Accounts = make_set(Account, 5) by Role, GrandParent, Parent, Process, Source
| sort by Role asc, Executions desc

rules.name: Connexions réseau du processus
rules.description: Destinations contactées par le processus (DeviceNetworkEvents) : URL ou IP, port, type d'adresse, nombre de connexions, premier et dernier contact, machines et lignes de commande.

reading.decisive: Moteur de script ou LOLBin (powershell, mshta, rundll32, node) qui contacte une destination publique récente.
reading.context: Destination IP sans nom de domaine (C2 résolu hors DNS, par exemple via une blockchain).
reading.noise: Mises à jour et télémétrie des éditeurs.

rules.name: Fichiers créés ou modifiés par le processus
rules.description: Fichiers créés, modifiés, renommés ou supprimés par le processus (DeviceFileEvents). Par exemple, depuis notepad.exe on retrouve les fichiers modifiés ; depuis 7z.exe ou winrar.exe, les archives créées.

reading.decisive: Archive volumineuse créée dans un dossier temporaire ou public avant un transfert sortant, ou exécutable déposé dans AppData.
reading.context: Fichiers renommés en masse (chiffrement), écriture dans le dossier Démarrage.
reading.noise: Fichiers temporaires et caches de l'application.

rules.name: Registre, tâches et services modifiés par le processus
rules.description: Modifications de persistance faites par le processus : clés de registre sensibles (DeviceRegistryEvents), tâches planifiées et services (DeviceEvents), et commandes schtasks, reg, sc qu'il a lancées (DeviceProcessEvents).

reading.decisive: Script ou binaire inconnu qui crée une tâche planifiée ou une clé Run pointant vers un fichier qu'il vient de déposer.
reading.context: Modification d'Image File Execution Options ou de Winlogon.
reading.noise: Installateurs signés qui créent leurs tâches de mise à jour.

rules.name: Timeline du processus
rules.description: Déroulé autour de T0 de ce que fait le processus : lancements (avec son parent), enfants, connexions réseau (premier contact par destination), fichiers écrits et clés de registre modifiées. Limité à 5 000 lignes. Renseigner le contexte HOST pour suivre une seule machine.

reading.decisive: Lancement depuis un parent inhabituel → fichier déposé → enfant LOLBin → connexion sortante.
reading.context: Écriture de clés de persistance par le processus.
reading.noise: Activité normale d'un processus très répandu (explorer, svchost) sans filtre de machine.

rules.name: Usage de l'application par IP
rules.description: Connexions et appels de l'application (AppId, identifiant de service principal ou nom) sur 14 jours, par source et par IP : service principal, identité managée, utilisateurs via l'application, Microsoft Graph. Établit la base des IP habituelles (CI, serveurs) et signale les IP apparues dans les deux derniers jours.

reading.decisive: IP jamais vue pour cette application, d'un hébergeur ou d'un pays inhabituel, utilisant un secret client.
reading.context: Hausse soudaine des appels Graph ou des échecs d'authentification.
reading.noise: Exécuteurs CI/CD dont les IP changent, poste du développeur qui teste en local.

rules.query:
// [AP-S1] Usage de l'application par IP — Statistics / Application
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.1.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 20160) * 1m; // défaut : 14d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // défaut : 1d
let StartTime = T0 - Before;
let EndTime = T0 + After;
// Indicateur Application : AppId (GUID), identifiant de service principal ou nom affiché.
let ValueApp = Value;
let ValueAppLower = tolower(Value);
// Connexions Entra ID interactives et non interactives, normalisées.
// Dans AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, DeviceDetail, Status et LocationDetails sont des chaînes JSON :
// elles sont analysées pour obtenir les mêmes colonnes que SigninLogs.
// Paramètres : start, end, ip (vide = toutes), upn (vide = tous). Résultat : 0 = succès.
let _Signins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string, upn:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status, SignInType = "Interactive"
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status), SignInType = "NonInteractive"
    )
    | extend
        DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
        DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId),
        OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
        Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
        IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged),
        IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
        TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
        City = tostring(_loc.city),
        FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
        Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    | project TimeGenerated, SignInType, UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName,
        ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason, Succeeded, IPAddress, Location, City, AutonomousSystemNumber,
        ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId, OperatingSystem, Browser, IsManaged, IsCompliant, TrustType,
        ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
};
union isfuzzy=true
(
    AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where AppId == ValueApp or ServicePrincipalId == ValueApp or ServicePrincipalName =~ ValueApp
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Service principal", IPAddress, Location, Identity = ServicePrincipalName,
        Success = ResultType == "0", Detail = strcat(ResourceDisplayName, " · ", ClientCredentialType)
),
(
    AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where AppId == ValueApp or ServicePrincipalId == ValueApp or ServicePrincipalName =~ ValueApp
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Identité managée", IPAddress, Location, Identity = ServicePrincipalName,
        Success = ResultType == "0", Detail = ResourceDisplayName
),
(
    _Signins(StartTime, EndTime, "", "")
    | where AppId == ValueApp or AppDisplayName =~ ValueApp
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Utilisateurs via l'application", IPAddress, Location, Identity = tolower(UserPrincipalName),
        Success = Succeeded, Detail = ResourceDisplayName
),
(
    MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where AppId == ValueApp or ServicePrincipalId == ValueApp
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Microsoft Graph", IPAddress, Location = "", Identity = coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId),
        Success = ResponseStatusCode < 400, Detail = RequestMethod
)
| summarize Events = count(), Successes = countif(Success), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    ActiveDays = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)), Identities = make_set(Identity, 10), Locations = make_set(Location, 5),
    Details = make_set(Detail, 5) by Source, IPAddress
| extend NewIP = FirstSeen > T0 - 2d
| sort by NewIP desc, Events desc

rules.name: Consentements, permissions et secrets de l'application
rules.description: Événements d'audit Entra ID qui concernent l'application : consentements (utilisateur ou administrateur), permissions déléguées et rôles d'application accordés, ajout de propriétaires, de secrets et de certificats. Extrait le type de consentement et les étendues (scopes).

reading.decisive: Consentement utilisateur à une application multi-tenant inconnue avec Mail.Read, Files.ReadWrite.All ou offline_access.
reading.context: Nouveau secret ajouté à une application existante par un compte qui n'en est pas propriétaire.
reading.noise: Consentements d'applications d'entreprise validées (visioconférence, CRM, signature électronique).

rules.name: Connexions et appels du service principal
rules.description: Connexions du service principal ou de l'identité managée (IP, ressource, résultat, type d'identifiant) et requêtes Microsoft Graph de l'application regroupées par méthode et chemin (identifiants remplacés par {id}).

reading.decisive: Connexions réussies avec secret client depuis une IP hors de la base, suivies d'appels Graph de lecture massive (messages, fichiers, utilisateurs).
reading.context: Taux d'échec élevé (secret testé), ressources inhabituelles (Key Vault, Azure Resource Manager).
reading.noise: Rotation de secrets, déploiements automatisés.

rules.name: Prévalence du hash
rules.description: Présence du fichier (MD5, SHA1 ou SHA256) sur 30 jours, par source : fichiers écrits, processus lancés, DLL chargées, événements Defender et pièces jointes d'e-mails (SHA256 seulement). Donne machines, noms et chemins, et une ligne de total. Le contexte HOST restreint à une machine.

reading.decisive: Fichier vu sur une seule machine, sous un nom de logiciel connu, dans un dossier utilisateur.
reading.context: Même hash reçu en pièce jointe puis exécuté sur plusieurs machines.
reading.noise: Binaires de mises à jour récentes encore peu répandus.

rules.name: Machines et chemins du fichier
rules.description: Machines, chemins et noms sous lesquels le fichier apparaît, avec les actions vues (écrit, exécuté, chargé), les comptes et les processus à l'origine. Le contexte HOST restreint à une machine.

reading.decisive: Même fichier dans le même chemin sur plusieurs machines, exécuté (propagation ou campagne).
reading.context: Fichier renommé (noms différents pour un même hash).
reading.noise: Copies de logiciels déployés par l'IT.

rules.name: Origine du fichier
rules.description: D'où vient le fichier : URL, référent et IP d'origine du téléchargement, processus qui l'a écrit (navigateur, Outlook, archiveur) et, s'il est arrivé par e-mail, expéditeur, destinataire et sujet. Le contexte HOST restreint à une machine.

reading.decisive: URL d'origine sur un domaine récent ou typosquatté, référent publicitaire, ou pièce jointe d'un expéditeur nouveau.
reading.context: Fichier extrait d'une archive (écrit par 7z.exe, WinRAR ou explorer.exe).
reading.noise: Téléchargements depuis les sites officiels des éditeurs.
